sources.title: vxvware three-list pool join for cyclic propus families (A symmetric, B = C): run at n=65, 2026-11-23 to 2026-11-24 (the search code is not in the repository; the run record is the artifact)

Djokovic, Hadamard matrices: skew of orders 276, 292 and symmetric 372, arXiv:2301.02751: states that the odd v below 100 with no symmetric Hadamard matrix of order 4v known are 65, 89 and 93; not the source of these rows

notes: Found on 2026-11-24 by a sampling search over the cyclic group Z_65: a propus difference family, that is, blocks (A, B, B, D) with A symmetric and two blocks equal. The row sums are 9, 7, 7, 9 and the supplementary difference sets have parameters (65; 28, 29, 29, 28; 49). B and D are not symmetric and have no multiplier symmetry. List A is every symmetric row of its row sum; rows of B and D whose periodic autocorrelations lie in fixed windows form two pools, and the three lists are joined exactly. This is a sample and not a census. The Goethals-Seidel array of these rows is a Hadamard matrix of order 260 and is not symmetric. The symmetric Hadamard matrix of order 260 comes from the propus array: with R the back-diagonal permutation matrix, the block rows (A, BR, BR, DR), (BR, D^T R, -A, -B^T R), (BR, -A, -D^T R, B^T R), (DR, -B^T R, B^T R, -A); the verifier does not check that matrix. The second source lists v = 65 among the odd v below 100 with no symmetric Hadamard matrix of order 4v known. A search of the literature and public repositories on 2026-11-24 found no earlier propus difference family in Z_65; it found one symmetric Hadamard matrix of order 260, posted in October 2026 in a public repository that is not peer reviewed, built by a bordered construction over Z_64 without circulant blocks of order 65. This reports the search and does not claim priority, and the result has not been reviewed.
